name: Soloblog
description: A self-hosted blog for one writer: markdown posts, 35 colour palettes, comments, the fediverse.

SETUP_TOKEN.description: The one-time code first-time setup asks for. Made for you - find it in Settings > Config Vars.

BASE_URL.description: Optional. Your address, fixed here - left blank, it's the one you open first-time setup at, and Settings changes it.

S3_BUCKET.description: Heroku's disk is wiped on every restart - Soloblog keeps everything in this bucket and restores itself from it. See docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.

S3_ENDPOINT.description: R2/Backblaze address; leave empty for Amazon S3.
